title: SAMPLE: Benghazi pumping station reported offline, restoration unknown
summary: A sample water-operations note said one pumping station in Benghazi was offline. Tanker substitutes were mentioned without volumes.
whatHappened: A sample municipal operations note said a pumping station in Benghazi stopped during the night of 1 September 2026. The note said tanker distribution was being arranged. No restoration time was given.
whyItMatters: Water pumping outages affect households and health facilities. Unknown restoration is not the same as a resolved incident.
watchNext: A restoration timestamp, or confirmation that tanker operations are actually running.
confidenceRationale: Single municipal-style note; restoration still unknown.
